citation: Sri Lanka Facts. Census Atlas 2024 private preview (v2026.11.4-preview.1).

indicator.definition: Mean number of persons per occupied housing unit, computed as total population ÷ occupied housing units. This is not the mean household size: one housing unit can contain more than one household, and the 2024 census reports 6,111,315 households against 6,030,541 occupied housing units nationally.
indicator.name: Persons per occupied housing unit
